title: VLT Project Command v6
description: Collaboration v6. Adds the shared notebook and path-free external plugin parameter fingerprints. Session mode, conductor, playback, monitoring and moderation use the separate server-authoritative session control contract. COLOR is a fixed source-channel tape/tube stage with a persistent component profile.

value.$comment: The runtime enforces this limit in UTF-8 bytes.

notebookCuesPayload.$comment: Runtime limits each text to 4096 UTF-8 bytes and combined cue text to 262144 UTF-8 bytes.

renderWarp.$comment: Runtime enforces unique ids, strictly increasing marker coordinates, first target beat 0 and locked first/last markers.

renderSource.$comment: Runtime also enforces fades within duration, nonoverlapping comp ranges within the source, existing take references and asset integrity.

renderStatePayload.$comment: History ids are unique; parentId references an earlier entry; versionId references an entry when history is nonempty. The server validates referenced assets atomically.
